Bug_Title: MS: Field should be both final and package protected (MS_FINAL_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A mutable static field could be changed by malicious code or
       by accident from another package.
       The field could be made package protected and/or made final
  to avoid
       this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring a public static mutable field'mutableStaticField'. This field can be accessed and modified from any class, which violates the principle of encapsulation and can lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by modifying the mutable static field directly and calling non-static methods from a static context indirectly through an instance.
